issues.explanation: «تطابق» is not an approved term; the terminology rules mandate «انطباق» for both conformity and compliance. The phrase «سطح‌های تطابق» should read «سطح‌های انطباق».
issues.quote: سایر ادعاهای آن جدول‌ها (از جمله سطح‌های تطابق و ردیف‌های مربوط به ISO/IEC 27001، 27005 و 27701…)
issues.suggested_fix: Replace «سطح‌های تطابق» with «سطح‌های انطباق»; if the distinction between conformity and compliance is relevant here, append «(conformity)» or «(compliance)» as appropriate.

issues.explanation: The assertion that fairness appears in Annexes B/C «not as an Annex A control» is a factual negative claim about Annex A content. The cited evidence covers only Annexes B (S42001-130, S42001-155) and C (S42001-168); no Annex A item from 42001 is supplied to corroborate what Annex A does or does not list. The review rules require judgement against CITED EVIDENCE ONLY, and no item establishes the content of 42001 Annex A controls. (By contrast, the dark-patterns correction in the same bullet set correctly adds the qualifier «searched the verified evidence».)
issues.quote: the printed text lists fairness only as an example objective in Annexes B/C, not as an Annex A control.
issues.suggested_fix: Add the same qualification used for the dark-patterns correction: append «(searched the verified evidence)» directly after «not as an Annex A control», so the reader knows this is an absence attested by the compiler's search rather than a positively evidenced statement.
